edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender which is assigned to _owner in the Ownable constructor, giving the deployer privileged control.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() (msg.sender) to authorize privileged calls.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of BlacklistBot.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of RenounceOwnership.
The user parameter flows into the _enable[user] = enable store, letting the owner blacklist any address.
The enable boolean parameter is the value written into the _enable mapping.
The uni_ parameter is written into the _uni state variable used by the transfer gate.
BlacklistBot mutates the _enable permission mapping that governs sell restrictions.
BlacklistBot executes the _enable[user] = enable state write.
RenounceOwnership writes an owner-chosen address into _uni.
RenounceOwnership executes the _uni = uni_ store.
_beforeTokenTransfer reads _uni to decide whether the transfer gate applies.
_beforeTokenTransfer reads the _enable mapping to check sender permissions.
_beforeTokenTransfer executes the require(_enable[from]) gate that can revert transfers.
The _enable[from] value is consumed by the reverting require gate.
_transfer invokes the overridden _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
transfer delegates the state-changing logic to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to the internal _transfer.
msg.sender determines the sender whose balance is debited by transfer.
The cached senderBalance local is used in the subtraction that writes _balances[sender].
_transfer performs the sender subtraction and recipient addition on _balances.
The recipient parameter identifies the balance entry that is incremented.
_mint updates the total supply after the cap check.
The mint operation increases the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor calls the overridden _mint to create the initial 1e9 token supply.
The constructor sets _enable[deployer] = true, seeding the permission mapping.
The amount parameter flows into the supply and balance increase during minting.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][caller] into the currentAllowance local.
currentAllowance - amount is computed and written back through _approve.
transferFrom reaches the _approve allowance store to reduce the spender allowance.
The from parameter is the key used for the _enable permission lookup in the hook.
The to parameter is compared with _uni to decide whether to enforce the gate.
The amount parameter is passed into the before-transfer hook.
The account parameter is the beneficiary of the minted tokens.
The sender parameter selects the account debited by transferFrom.
The amount parameter drives both the transfer and the allowance decrease.
The amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer in the transfer function.

normalization_plan.reason: The user parameter has no independent semantics outside the BlacklistBot access-controlled state write.
The enable flag only exists as the value assigned inside BlacklistBot.
The uni_ parameter is only meaningful as the value stored by RenounceOwnership.
The account parameter is only used as the mint recipient inside the overridden _mint.
The amount parameter is only used for the cap check and supply increase in _mint.
The from parameter is consumed solely by the hook's permission lookup.
The to parameter is only used to compare against _uni inside the hook.
The amount parameter is merely forwarded into the hook signature.
The recipient parameter is only used to forward the call to _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used to forward the call to _transfer.
The sender parameter is only used within transferFrom for the transfer and allowance lookup.
The amount parameter is only used within transferFrom for the transfer and allowance math.
The senderBalance local exists only to perform the balance subtraction store.
The currentAllowance local exists only to compute the allowance written by _approve.
